title: It’s Okay
text: It’s Okay. This is a nice set, comfortable to stand on and looks great. My issues are that the backing isn’t non slip and they pick up every piece of dirt/dust possible. Also the toilet lid cover is just the material with 2 elastic bands to slide it onto the lid, so it doesn’t stay in place very well.

product_metadata.title: FEELSO Memory Foam Bath Mat Set, 3 Piece Bathroom Rugs Non Slip and Absorbent Mats, 20x31 Inches Floor Mat, 20x22 Inches U-Shaped Contour Rug and Toilet Lid Cover for Tub Shower & Bath Room, Gray
features: 【Extra Softness And Durable】 The Memory Foam bathroom mat sets are composed of 3 layers: fabric layer, middle sponge layer and bottom anti-skid layer, which is very soft and durable for long term usage. The two floor mats protects you from cold bathroom floor, and the toilet lid cover provides protection to your toilet lid from scratches and damage.

【Anti-slip Backing】 Skid-resistant bottom is made of high quality PVC material. This anti-skid backing helps keeping the mat firmly in place, that it won't slip or slide, keeping you more safe and cozy. Note: please make sure to place rugs on dry smooth floor only.

【Absorbency】 The memory foam rugs can absorb water quickly. It has strong water-absorbent ability because of the extremely plush top layer of the memory foam, which absorb extra water and moisture in your bathroom, helping to keep your room floors clean and dry.

【Machine Washable】 The FEELSO Memory Foam mat is super easy to clean and it dries quickly! Simply machine wash on cold water with mild detergent and hang to dry or air dry flat. The super soft material will not shrink or turn rough after the wash.

【Lifetime Guarantee】 Life time warranty guarantied by FEELSO. If you are not full satisfied with your rugs, then please do not hesitate and reach out to us through Amazon at any time for either apply a refund or replacement.
